```{r include=FALSE, cache=FALSE, message=FALSE}
#here::here("code", "qmd_global_options.R") |> source() 
```


```{r}

here::i_am("Submitted to Cambridge - Nov 2026/chapter-abstracts.qmd")
chapter_dir <- here::here("") # Change to your folder path

files <- list.files(
  chapter_dir,
  pattern = "^ch[0-9]+-.*\\.(qmd|md|txt)$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

if (length(files) == 0) {
  stop("No chapter files found in ", chapter_dir)
}

# Sort numerically: ch1, ch2, ..., ch10.
chapter_number <- as.integer(
  sub("^ch([0-9]+)-.*$", "\\1", basename(files), ignore.case = TRUE)
)
files <- files[order(chapter_number)]
chapter_number <- sort(chapter_number)

extract_abstract <- function(path) {
  lines <- readLines(path, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")
  matches <- grep("^> ABSTRACT: ", lines, value = TRUE)
  if (!length(matches)) {
    warning("No abstract found in: ", basename(path))
    return(NA_character_)
  }
sub("^> ABSTRACT:\\s*", "", matches[1])
}

extract_title <- function(path) {
  lines <- readLines(path, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")
  matches <- grep("^# ", lines, value = TRUE)
  if (!length(matches)) {
    warning("No title found in: ", basename(path))
    return(NA_character_)
  }
  title <- sub("^#\\s+", "", matches[1])        # drop the leading "# "
  sub("\\s*\\{#[^}]*\\}\\s*$", "", title)        # drop labels like {#sec-intro}
}

abstracts <- data.frame(
  number   = chapter_number,
  title    = vapply(files, extract_title, character(1)),
  abstract = vapply(files, extract_abstract, character(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) |>
  tidyr::drop_na(title)
```

```{r}
#| results: asis

for (i in seq_len(nrow(abstracts))) {
  cat("\n\n## Chapter ", abstracts$number[i], ": ", abstracts$title[i], "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(abstracts$abstract[i], "\n\n")
}
```
